selection_rule: Use both previously fixed opposite signed 239E Dragon rounds, each two exact disjoint post-buy ranges, not later chosen according to observed profit. Report EVERY Swap log and every truncation; never silently drop losers or swap to another market.
read_schedule: Before logs, check historical V2 pair token0 and token1 for fixed R1 first range start using selector 0x0dfe1681 and 0xd21220a7
Issue exact four ethGetLogs Pair Swap queries with the four 12/13-block bounded scopes; no query wider than frozen scope
Read original owner ERC20 balanceOf at end of each of four frozen windows with fixed selector 0x70a08231
If provider output >8,098 chars, mark window TRUNCATED and do not derive exact event count or completeness

If full logs with eligible buy-direction Swap, signers must be obtained from original ethGetTransactionByHash in a NEW separately precommitted batch; current Pair indexed sender/to are NOT necessarily owner/signer
Do not claim each window is at +1/+5/+15 actual seconds; timestamps must come from real block/tx data
No follow profitability inferred from Swap event alone, no actual external BUY and SELL until EOA signature/receipt/native balances are independently checked
signal_still_holding_requirements: Return actual ERC20 balanceOf(original 239E owner) at every scope end; nonzero confirms end-block position only and does not retroactively prove intrablock availability.
